title: Keyboard Manager shortcuts stop working after a few minutes

judgment.rationale: PR #49644 fixed a specific Quick Accent false-start key-up suppression path related to a subset of these shortcut failures. The issue was reopened because the broader report was only partly improved, so the merged change must not be treated as a complete resolution.
evidence: The issue reports Keyboard Manager shortcuts stopping after several minutes and has nine comments.
PR #49644 changes Quick Accent's false-start handling so the matching owner-letter key-up passes through.
A later report says the problem improved only partially and the issue was reopened.
judgment.recommended_action: Retain #49644 as the existing partial fix and re-test the original remaining shortcut-loss sequence on current stable before opening a separate design.

fix_assessment.rationale: A merged fix addresses one specific false-start path but the open issue documents residual behavior. Do not propose a competing fix until the remaining sequence is isolated.

issue_context.summary: A Quick Accent key-up suppression fix addressed part of the shortcut-loss behavior, but the issue remained open after the reporter said the broader symptom persisted.
known_information: The issue reports Keyboard Manager shortcuts stop working after a few minutes.
PR #49644 merged a change to pass through the owner-letter key-up after a Quick Accent false start.
The reporter later said the issue improved only partially and reopened the issue.
inferences: The Quick Accent false-start path may explain one reported manifestation, but cannot explain all remaining failures.
Residual shortcut loss may involve another event path or an independent report in the thread.
issue_context.analysis: Avoid marking the entire issue fixed or proposing a duplicate design. Establish which exact sequence still fails on current stable after the existing change, then assess whether the remaining symptom has an independent owner.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and all nine comments, including the reopen/partial-fix report.
Reviewed the merged #49644 change in PowerAccentKeyboardService/KeyboardListener.cpp; it is specific to the false-start owner-letter key-up.

reproduce.title: Isolate shortcut loss not covered by the Quick Accent fix
prerequisites: A clean profile with the reported Keyboard Manager shortcut configuration.
Quick Accent enabled only if it was part of the failing reporter setup.
steps: Record the exact shortcut and focused application that fail in the issue's remaining scenario.
Run the scenario with Quick Accent enabled and note whether a false-start sequence occurs before shortcut loss.
Repeat with Quick Accent disabled while keeping the Keyboard Manager mapping unchanged.
Compare the event sequence against the #49644 owner-letter key-up pass-through behavior.
reproduce.expected_result: The specific residual failure is either eliminated by #49644 or reproduced independently with enough evidence to identify a separate path.
